## Summary
Briefly describe what this PR does.  Focus on implementation / approach (not details about the problem or feature which are included in the issue)


## Rationale
Explain why the breaking change is justified. Include trade-offs, alternatives considered, and long-term benefits.


## Breaking Changes
Describe what is breaking, listing affected modules, APIs, or interfaces.


## Migration Guide
Describe error(s) or indication(s) developer will encounter if migration guide is not followed.
Provide instructions for users to update their code or configuration to be compatible with this change.  If feasible provide script or means to automate migration.


## Implementation Notes
Highlight any design decisions, trade-offs, or deviations from the issue


## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing performed

If Manually tested, describe the tests ran to verify changes. Provide instructions so others can reproduce.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have documented breaking changes
- [ ] I have provided a robust migration guide
- [ ] My Code changes follow the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard to understand areas
- [ ] I have verified all build configurations succeed
